instruction: I am an NLP researcher working on a bibliography. Search the ACL Anthology website for the ACL 2022 best paper award and add it to row 2 of the table best_awards_acl.xlsx on the desktop. Include the title, year (which should be 2022), complete author list (comma-separated), and official ACL Anthology PDF link.
